大劫主计划，二十阶巅峰的秘密！（大劫主计划，二十阶巅峰的秘密！（第22页）“那被选中的大劫主也在暗自成长。”“如今那大劫主据说已经成长到了二十阶后期，距离二十阶巅峰也只有临门一脚，正到了突破的紧要关头，却不知哪里走漏了风声，黑暗天祖庙那边也得知了消息。”“如今除了十大天祖还有在黑暗天祖庙中闭关准备突破到二十阶巅峰的古祖，整个虚空的黑暗古祖几乎都疯狂的扑向了那大劫主所在的位置。”“而我们是被派过去驰援那边的。”“至于这些黑暗古祖，应当也是去帮忙诛杀大劫主的。”洛凡尘恍然大悟，原来如此。如此之多的大界培养出来的“大劫主”，不用想都知道功参造化，拥有远超同境的实力，一旦突破到二十阶巅峰，那黑暗天祖庙再想出手击杀就太难了，所以趁“大劫主”没突破的时候，赶忙派人过去劫杀。洛凡尘询问：“你们可知道那大劫主的实力怎么样？”天音祖师摇头，对此一无所知。风祖道：“我倒是了解一些小道消息。”“据说这大劫主修行不足三千年就踏入了二十阶后期，天生亲近各界大道，修出了各个大界强者联合为他推衍的无上修行路线。”“足足有三百六十一条序列之道，每一条道路的尽头都完全不同。”“寻常大界传人一生恐怕都难以在一条序列上走到尽头，而这大劫主足足三百六十一条序列之道同修，承受的痛苦和煎熬更是只修行一条序列之道的无数倍。”“如今这大劫主虽然只有二十阶后期的修为，但应该是二十阶后期无敌，没有对手，对付普通，甚至是超强层次的二十阶巅峰强者应当都没有问题。”众人都以为洛凡尘听完会流露出震撼的表情，哪里想到这家伙古井无波，甚至还打了个瞌睡。“等等！”洛凡尘敏锐察觉到了关键点。“这二十阶巅峰有什么特殊的地方吗？”“还分什么普通和超强？”风祖等人嘴角一抽，感觉这血魔古祖实力通天，但怎么像是一点常识都没有一样。“你不知道吗？”风祖忍不住问。“啪！”山海之主抬起蒲扇大的手掌，在他脑壳上扇了一下。“你废什么话啊。”“教主大人不过是想考考你罢了。”风祖嘴角抽搐，亏之前我们还想救你，就踏马你当舔狗舔的最凶。风祖还是乖乖道：“回禀教主大人。”“这二十阶巅峰距离二十一阶太远了，远到无论修行多久，都突破不到二十一阶，甚至看不到突破的影子。”“虽然突破不到二十一阶，但在二十阶巅峰修行的越久，越能感受到自己有所突破，最终在二十阶巅峰这个境界上，因为走出去的路途远度不同，底蕴不同，又划分出了不同的战力水平。”“哦？”洛凡尘挑眉，觉得这样就合理了。此前感受到黑暗天祖的力量，压迫感太强了。那哪里像是只差了一个小境界的样子。“这二十阶巅峰战力是如何划分的？”

Chapter 3065: The Great Tribulation Master’s Plan for the 20th Level Peak (Page 1)
The Great Tribulation Master Plan, the secret of the peak of the 20th level! (The Great Tribulation Master Plan, the Secret of the 20th Level Peak! (Page 22) "The selected Great Tribulation Lord is also growing secretly." "Now the Great Tribulation Lord is said to have grown to the late 20th level, and is only one step away from the 20th level peak. It is at the critical moment of breakthrough, but the news leaked out somewhere, and the Dark Heavenly Ancestral Temple also learned the news." "Now, in addition to the top ten Heavenly Ancestors, there are also other people in the Dark Heavenly Ancestral Temple. As the ancient ancestors retreated to reach the peak of the 20th level, almost all the dark ancestors in the void rushed towards the location of the great tribulation lord. "And we were sent to rush over there to help." "As for these dark ancient ancestors, they should also be helping to kill the great tribulation lord." Luo Fanchen suddenly realized that this was the case. It doesn't take much to think about the "great tribulation lords" cultivated by so many great realms. The strength far exceeds that of the same level. Once it breaks through to the peak of the 20th level, it will be too difficult for the Dark Tianzu Temple to kill him, so before the "Great Tribulation Lord" breaks through, Luo Fanchen asks: "Do you know the strength of the Great Tribulation Lord?" Patriarch Tianyin shook his head, knowing nothing about it. "I know some gossip." "It is said that this Great Tribulation Lord has been practicing for less than three thousand years. He entered the late 20th level and was born to be close to the avenues of all walks of life, and he developed the supreme cultivation route that was jointly deduced for him by powerful men from all major realms. "There are a total of three hundred and sixty-one sequences of paths, and the end of each path is completely different." "It is probably difficult for ordinary successors of the great realm to reach the end of one sequence in their lifetime, but the pain and suffering endured by the practitioners of the three hundred and sixty-one sequences of the Great Tribulation Master are even more severe." "Although this Great Tribulation Lord is only at the late 20th level, he should be invincible and has no opponent. He should have no problem against ordinary or even super-powerful 20th level experts." Everyone thought that Luo Fanchen would show a shocked expression after hearing this, but they didn't expect that this guy Gujing Wubo even took a nap. "Wait a minute!" Sensing the key point. "Is there anything special about this twenty-level peak?" "What's the difference between ordinary and super?" Fengzu and others twitched, feeling that this ancient blood demon had great strength, but it seemed like he had no common sense. "Don't you know?" Fengzu couldn't help but ask. "Pah!" The Lord of Shanhai raised his palm as big as a leaf fan and slapped him on the head. "What nonsense are you talking about?" I just want to test you." The corner of Feng Zu's mouth twitched. We wanted to save you before, but you were the most vicious licker. Feng Zu still said obediently, "Report to the leader." "The peak of the 20th level is too far away from the 21st level. No matter how long you practice, you can't break through the 21st level, and you can't even see the breakthrough." "Although you can't break through the 21st level, the longer you practice at the 20th level. The more I can feel that I have made a breakthrough, finally at the level of the 20th level, because of the different distances and backgrounds, there are different levels of combat power. ""Oh?" Luo Fanchen raised his eyebrows, thinking that this makes sense. He felt the power of the Dark Heavenly Ancestor before, and the sense of oppression was too strong. So it seems that he is only a small level away. "How is the level of the 20th level of peak combat strength divided?"
